content: One measured Electron-to-Tauri 2 rewrite (MarkShot, Windows ARM64) reports install 259 MB to 5.8 MB, working set 291 MB to 25 MB, but startup slower: 418 ms Electron vs 644 ms Tauri. General comparison tables claim lower Tauri idle memory (3-10x) and faster startup, but measurements vary by app and cold/warm launch. No universal startup win.
